about.title: About Goa
about.lede: Goa grew out of spreadsheets — the ones a group of friends kept to run a film club and a reading club. It automates that work: people log their progress, the system does the maths, and the result becomes a memory.
body: The idea is simple. A group picks a challenge — watch a list of films, read for 90 days, keep a habit — and each person logs their progress. Goa handles the rest: it tracks who's on schedule, computes averages and rankings, and at the end builds a showcase that tells the story of that round.
Nothing is public by default. Every group is private, access always comes from belonging to it, and submitted entries are preserved — only the curation and presentation stay editable.
Goa is a personal project in progress, built by Eduardo Dourado. The original spreadsheets became the domain spec; the app is gradually catching up to everything they did, with far less manual work.
